_comment: Copy to <DATA_ROOT>/roster.json (gitignored) and fill in. Canonical names + aliases for entity resolution in stage 3 — this is what fixes ASR proper-noun errors and merges 'first name vs last name vs nickname' into one entity. Optional 'forbid' lists wrong spellings that are hard-replaced with the canonical name after the model runs (use when a strong prior keeps overriding the roster, e.g. Beowolf/Beowulf). Longer term, build this from the app's npcs table + character sheets, keeping this file as a nicknames supplement.

npcs.name: Full NPC Name
npcs.note: one NPC the table calls by different names
